subjectivity.intro: Your self-model — taste, judgment, what you care about. Private unless you mark a note citable. Write here or by talking to your AI; both land in the same place.

citable.label: citable — appears in the answer's references
citable.help: With this off, the AI still reads this note and still uses it to shape its answer — it just isn't listed under REFERENCES. This is the attribution switch, not the secrecy switch: to stop the AI reading it at all, take its corpus URI back on /admin/roles or on the code.

search.label: find
search.placeholder: words from the note — title or body
search.idleHint: the list below is the newest page; search looks at the whole corpus
search.found: {count, plural, one {# entry matches} other {# entries match}} “{query}” — searched the whole corpus, not just this page
search.foundCapped: showing the first {count} matches for “{query}” — searched the whole corpus; narrow the words to see fewer
search.none: no match for “{query}” in the whole corpus. This index is lexical: substrings inside a word, terms glued to punctuation and CJK all tokenize badly, so empty does not prove the note isn't there — try a distinctive whole word from it.

seoEditor.heading: public landing (url is tree-derived from the title)
seoEditor.indexed: published — a public page lives at this URL, and it is listed in sitemap.xml

scope.kept: kept as written (not on the tree):
scope.referable: referable — this entry can appear as a cited source
scope.notReferable: readable but not referable — the AI reads it, it is never cited

wiki.empty: No wiki entries yet. Use + new entry, promote from /admin/raw, or call MCP <tool>promote_to_wiki</tool>.

output.intro: Outputs are public-facing artifacts assembled from your wiki entries — downloadable PDFs, standalone web essays, investor decks. Each gets its own SEO landing at {slugPath}. Three visibilities: public (open to anyone, in sitemap), unlisted (only visible with a code), private (specific code scopes only, never indexed).
output.empty: No output entries yet. Use + new output, promote from /admin/wiki, or call MCP <tool>promote_wiki_to_output</tool>.

raw.empty: No raw entries yet. Push one from an MCP client (raw_dump tool).

writings.intro: Owner-curated writings. Use the block editor below — type `/` for a block menu, or hand off to Claude via the `writing_create` MCP tool. Saved as canonical markdown either way.

obsidian.help: Import picks your Obsidian vault folder (wiki / subjectivity / raw / writings) and upserts the matching corpus notes by their vault path. Export downloads your corpus as a vault of markdown + frontmatter.
obsidian.noSync: No live sync, no file watcher — these two actions are the whole mechanism, and neither runs unless you run it.
